newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks struggle against profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks struggle against profit-taking.

text.p: Wall Street shares moved off session lows but remained weak on Monday, defending themselves against profit-taking and cautious ahead of quarterly results from International Business Machines Corp and a speech Tuesday from Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan.
The Dow Jones Industrial average was down around 12 points at 7878, above session lows but soft.
The Nasdaq composite, whose technology stocks led the broader market's declines on Friday, extended losses. It was down around 10 points at 1538.
The long bond was down 4/32 to yield 6.54 percent.
